independentNewDiffFindings.evidence: _offsetDraftRecoveryBlocked resets only in disk RestoreSession success; checkpoint-absent LoadSource success does not clear it. SaveLocalSession returns when flag true.
independentNewDiffFindings.scenario: A draft backup failure -> switch to fresh B with no checkpoint -> B LoadSource success -> B normal measurements never checkpoint.
independentNewDiffFindings.recommendedFix: Clear recovery-block flag when successfully opening a source/checkpoint path that is not the failed draft; retain protected original A bytes. Add A failure -> B valid checkpoint -> A retry regression.
independentNewDiffFindings.fix: Recovery protection now stores an absolute failed SessionPath and gates capture/save only for that path. Other model B can checkpoint normally while A original remains protected.

independentNewDiffFindings.evidence: RefreshSavedReviewOffsetPreview increments _savedOffsetReadEpoch for every call but has no in-flight guard; Root async timer can overlap awaited loads.
independentNewDiffFindings.scenario: Slow LoadLatest exceeding timer interval -> each later poll invalidates earlier completion, and exclusive file store reads can queue.
independentNewDiffFindings.recommendedFix: A per-recipe-preview in-flight guard released in finally, preserving source epoch and selected-model identity checks; test with a blocked fake store then a second poll.
independentNewDiffFindings.fix: RefreshSavedReviewOffsetPreview now uses Interlocked.CompareExchange in-flight guard and finally release; read epoch/model checks remain. File LoadLatest is offloaded to Task.Run.

evidence: Recipe Build throws OperationCanceledException on provider/epoch change even when supplied token is not canceled
Recipe.View sets new ViewRecipeId and requests current-screen refresh
Root.SetViewRecipeId only updates field and does not cancel screen-build token
Root.RefreshCurrentScreen while already running only sets pending flag; current Build continues with uncanceled token
Root catch(OperationCanceledException) is filtered to buildToken.IsCancellationRequested
independentNewDiffFindings.scenario: A Recipe Build awaits offset read -> user chooses VIEW model B -> root queues another refresh but does not cancel A token -> A provider mismatch throws OCE -> catch filter false, so exception escapes original async command even though a new Build may later be queued.
independentNewDiffFindings.recommendedFix: Ensure stale view changes cancel the owning Build token, or handle the internal stale-build cancellation explicitly at Root and retry latest selection. Test full top-level model switching while the read is blocked.
independentNewDiffFindings.fix: Root.RefreshCurrentScreen now treats Recipe OperationCanceledException as an obsolete build and retries the pending/current view instead of allowing it to escape the async command.
